sophia: Heads-up — Product plans to roll Oryx-30B public beta next Tue. Early perf run shows ~1.6x token/sec vs Amber-13B. Quick ask: can infra confirm GPU headroom + regional constraints? Need rough GPU-hours + cost for capacity decision.
vikram: Got it. Can you paste the test harness numbers (peak tok/s by region, seq len distribution, qps)? I’ll map to GPU-hours.
sophia: Quick paste from bench (internal run, 90%ile prompts ~512 tokens):
```
global_peak_tok_s: 28200
by_region: {us: 14200, eu: 9000, apac: 5200}
avg_seq_len: 480
baseline_model: amber-13b
observed_multiplier_vs_amber: 1.6
cache_hit_est: 18% (prefix reuse)
```
kai: Thanks. Some back-of-envelope numbers: Oryx-30B on A100-80GB fp16 ~= 1.8k tok/s per GPU under our current runtime (single-request latency SLO preserved). With int8/quant path we see ~3.6k tok/s per GPU in lab. So raw GPU count:
- fp16 path: 28200 / 1800 ≈ 16 GPUs
- int8 path: 28200 / 3600 ≈ 8 GPUs
Realistically add 35% headroom for bursts, health boundaries, async queueing -> fp16 ~22 GPUs, int8 ~11 GPUs.
audrey: APAC note: our APAC clusters currently have bandwidth caps on the L4 interconnect for a few AZs (ticket ENG-5278). If we send large KV caches or batched inputs cross-AZ we hit packet drops at scale. For APAC I’d recommend: (1) prefer int8 smaller-footprint variant + local cache warmup, or (2) route APAC -> nearest EU region for initial week.
ops-bot: Current pool headroom snapshot: total A100 spare capacity (all regions) = 28 GPUs; US spare = 10, EU spare = 9, APAC spare = 9. Threshold alarms: gpu_util_pct > 72% on any region triggers scale-warning.
cost-bot: Rough cost for steady-state reserved-like baseline (30 days):
- If we provision int8 path 11 GPUs global (24/7): 11 * 24 * 30 = 7,920 GPU-hours. Estimated infra bill ~ $3.25/hr -> ~$25.7k/mo.
- fp16 path 22 GPUs -> 15,840 GPU-hours -> ~$51.5k/mo.
(does not include bandwidth, storage, or reserved-contract discounts)
liam: Mitigations: staged rollout + canary routing by geo. Start with canary at 10% traffic (route to int8 variant), monitor tail latency and error rate. Also enable autoscale with a pre-warm pool: set min_replicas to 4 in each region and burst_capacity to +40%. Example autoscale tweak:
```yaml
route: /oryx-public
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  target_tok_s_per_replica: 3200
  burst_buffer_pct: 40
```
sophia: Sounds reasonable. Action items:
- @vikram please map the bench numbers to our cluster IDs and confirm which AZs can host int8 runtime by EOD. (SP-3421)
- @kai can you validate the 3.6k tok/s int8 number from prod-like harness and share 95%ile latency?
- @audrey escalate ENG-5278 if APAC interconnect still blocks local launches.
I’ll hold public launch until we have green on all three, but we can do a small canary next Tue.
vikram: On it — will post mapping in this thread after I reconcile with cluster tags.
kai: Running an A/B perf harness now against prod-runtime config. Expect numbers + p95 latency in ~3 hours.
audrey: Escalated ENG-5278 to netops with logs and replays, cc: @netops. If they can’t fix, we fallback APAC->EU routing for first week.
sophia: Perfect — ping here when done. :thumbsup:
